€4P. (गृध्यति, गृद्ध) 
__1 To covet; desire, strive after greedily. 
__2 To long for, be desirous of. 
-Caus. (गर्धयति) 
__1 To make desirous or greedy. 
__2 To deceive cheat (Ātm.); सीतां दिदृक्षुः प्रच्छन्नः सोऽगर्धयत राक्षसान् [[

a. [गृध्-कु] Lustful, libidinous. 
-धुः The God of love.

a. Bad, wicked. -f. 
__1 The wind escaping at the anus (अपान). 
__2 Understanding, reason, intellect.

गृध्यम्,
 
-ध्या a. [गृध् कर्माणि क्यप्] Desire, greediness.
a. Longed for, greedily desired; गृध्यमर्थमवाप्स्यसि [[

a. [गृध्-क्रन्] Greedy, covetous. 
-ध्रः, -ध्रम् A vulture; मार्जारस्य हि दोषेण हतो गृध्रो जरद्गवः [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-कूटः N. of a mountain near Rājagṛha. 
-पतिः, -राजः the lord of the vultures, an epithet of Jaṭāyu; अस्यैवासीन्महति शिखरे गृध्रराजस्य वासः [[

.]] 
-वाज, -वाजित a. furnished with vulture feathers (as an arrow).
a. Similar to a vulture (in greediness); eagerly desiring; [[
The mother of vultures a daughter of Kaśaypa and Tamrā.
